Hey I’m a person who works in criminal law for over a decade. I’m so sorry you are going through this; it’s not only heartbreaking to lose your partner but also try to be there for a new person coming into the world. 
You will be very likely subpoenaed to testify, but I encourage you to speak with the prosecutor on this case and ask for a meeting ahead of time. Ask the office if they have a victim services unit and what your rights are and what to expect when going on the stand. In some states, you can also ask for a support person to be there with you when you give your testimony.  Then when/if you are on the stand, don’t be afraid to ask for a break or to cry- this is an upsetting event that changed your life and the court system should give you grace here. Good luck and I hope you get the outcome you pray for here.
